protocol.title: Cellular Decision Making by Non-Integrative Processing of TLR Inputs
protocol.platform: Automated microfluidic cell culture + widefield live-cell fluorescence microscopy
cell_lines: Mouse 3T3 fibroblasts p65-DsRed (p65^(-/-) background, near-endogenous p65 promoter, H2B-GFP nuclear marker)
protocol.objective: Combinatorial TLR2/TLR4 co-stimulation in single cells to study NF-kB dynamic profiles, bagging classifier-based response classification (LPS-like vs PAM-like vs uncertain), sequential cross-tolerance stimulation, and miR-146a TaqMan qPCR validation of slow negative feedback

device.stimulation_mode: Step increase via media exchange (chamber perfusion)
device.atmosphere: 5% CO2, 37 C (incubation chamber on microscope stage)
device.reference: Kellogg et al., Nat. Protoc. 2014; Gomez-Sjoberg et al., Anal. Chem. 2007

reagents.cell_media: DMEM (5% CO2-equilibrated, kept on ice before delivery)
reagents.surface_coating: Fibronectin (adsorbed to PDMS chamber surface before cell seeding)

tlr4_agonist.name: Ultrapure LPS
tlr4_agonist.specificity: TLR4-exclusive; does not activate TLR2 (Fujihara et al. 2003; Lee et al. 2009)
tlr4_agonist.preparation: Diluted in DMEM in separate vials, pressured with 5% CO2, kept on ice

tlr2_agonist.name: Pam3CSK4 (PAM)
tlr2_agonist.description: Synthetic triacylated lipopeptide; activates TLR2 via endosomal processing
tlr2_agonist.preparation: Diluted in DMEM in separate vials, pressured with 5% CO2, kept on ice
tlr2_agonist.reference: Brandt et al. 2013; Stack et al. 2014

reagents.cdna_synthesis: TaqMan microRNA reverse transcription kit (Applied Biosystems)
reagents.mirna_probe: TaqMan miRNA-specific assay hsa-miR-146a (cross-reactive with murine miR-146a)
reagents.endogenous_control: snoRNA234 small nuclear RNA (snRNA; Applied Biosystems)

bulk_stimulation_doses_qpcr_ng_mL.note: Intermediate doses used for bulk qPCR time-course; separate from microfluidic single-cell doses

imaging.nfkb_quantification: Mean nuclear DsRed intensity / mean cytoplasm DsRed intensity
imaging.analysis_software: CellProfiler (automated tracking) + custom MATLAB (peak detection via mspeaks; smoothing via smooth function)

classifier.training_data: Single-stimulus LPS and PAM NF-kB trajectories at matched doses
classifier.classification_rule: LPS-like if >nu fraction of trees vote LPS; PAM-like if >nu fraction vote PAM; Uncertain otherwise
classifier.artificial_mixed_check: 1000 artificial mixed trajectories (LPS + PAM training trace sums) tested; majority classified as mixed/uncertain confirming classifier validity

steps.name: Fibronectin chamber coating
steps.notes: Fibronectin adsorbed to PDMS chamber surface to promote 3T3 fibroblast adhesion. PBS wash removes excess.

steps.name: Cell seeding and pre-culture
steps.notes: Periodic media replenishment during pre-culture. Cells reach ~80% confluence before stimulation.

steps.name: Pre-stimulation media refresh
steps.notes: Fresh DMEM delivered to remove conditioned media and establish baseline NF-kB level before stimulus.

steps.name: Combinatorial LPS x PAM co-stimulation (9-condition matrix)
steps.delivery: Step increase via microfluidic chamber media exchange
steps.chip_parallelism: All 9 conditions run in parallel on a single chip
steps.notes: Stimulus vials pressured with 5% CO2, kept on ice. Chamber sealed post-delivery. Condition C9 (LPS 11 / PAM 4.4 ng/mL) used as primary CFG gate condition -- most distinct LPS-like vs PAM-like dynamics.

steps.name: NF-kB live imaging and bagging classifier detection

pass.interpretation: Non-integrative processing confirmed; >80% cells are LPS-like or PAM-like, <15-20% uncertain
pass.action: dispose all co-stim chambers; proceed to sequential stimulation arm

steps.name: Sequential stimulation Scheme A: LPS first, PAM at +2 hr

results_fig5c.interpretation: Rapid NF-kB negative feedback (IkB, A20, miR-146a) induced by LPS prevents PAM response in 53% of cells. Remaining 30% were LPS-refractory and caught by PAM at +2 hr.

steps.name: Sequential stimulation Scheme B: PAM first, LPS at +4 hr

second_stimulus.note: High-dose LPS used to maximally challenge PAM-pre-activated cells

steps.rationale_for_240min_interval: Ensures miR-146a is fully induced (onset ~2 hr post-PAM; sustained for several hours) before second stimulus

results_fig5d.interpretation: Moderate PAM 13.3 ng/mL activated all cells. A20 / miR-146a negative feedback sufficient to block even high-dose LPS in 84% of pre-activated cells. Demonstrates cross-TLR tolerance through shared TRAF6 node.

pass.interpretation: Cross-tolerance confirmed; majority of pre-stimulated cells refractory to second stimulus
pass.action: dispose sequential chambers; proceed to miR-146a validation

fail.interpretation: No cross-tolerance; cells respond to both stimuli

steps.name: miR-146a TaqMan qPCR validation
steps.purpose: Mechanistic validation of miR-146a as slow sustained negative feedback mediating PAM response shutoff and TLR cross-tolerance

cdna_synthesis.kit: TaqMan microRNA reverse transcription kit (Applied Biosystems)

qpcr.assay: TaqMan miRNA-specific assay hsa-miR-146a (cross-reactive murine miR-146a)

results_fig2c.expression_profile: Sustained high expression for >6 hr (unlike IkB/A20 which return to baseline)
results_fig2c.feedback_type: Slow, ultrasensitive negative feedback targeting TRAF6 mRNA (IRAK1/2 also targeted)

pass.interpretation: Sustained miR-146a induction confirmed; validates model slow feedback mechanism

mathematical_model.base_model: Extended from Kellogg et al. eLife 2015 (TLR4/LPS) and Tay et al. Nature 2010
mathematical_model.noise_model: Receptor-level extrinsic noise only; TLR4 and TLR2 total counts follow log-normal distributions
key_mechanistic_features: TLR4 (LPS): surface membrane signalling; rapid TRAF6 accumulation
TLR2 (PAM): endosomal processing; slow TRAF6 accumulation (low binding rate kf, low unbinding rate kr models internalization as integrator)
Slow feedback: miR-146a (Hill coefficient 4, ultrasensitive); targets TRAF6 mRNA
Cell-to-cell variability from TLR receptor number lognormal distribution
mathematical_model.chamber_volume_calculation: 1 ng/mL LPS -> 2.4e4 ligands/cell; 1 ng/mL PAM -> 1.6e5 ligands/cell (MW: LPS 10 kDa, PAM 1509.6 Da)
mathematical_model.non_integrative_mechanism: LPS activates first (no endosomal delay); IkB/A20/miR-146a feedback prevents PAM response in TLR4-sensitive cells. TLR4-refractory cells receive PAM signal unimpeded -> PAM-like response. Switch-like NF-kB activation polarises each cell to one outcome.
mathematical_model.excluded_pathway: TRIF-mediated TLR4 pathway excluded (inactive in 3T3 fibroblasts; Alexander Hoffmann personal communication)
